heading: Suriya, Jyotika reveal why they chose Scotland for their vow renewal: ‘We came home carrying something greater than memories’
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 12:48 IST
paragraphs: Suriya and Jyotika have given fans another glimpse into their anniversary celebrations in Scotland, sharing a new video from their intimate vow renewal ceremony
Along with moments from the special occasion, Suriya revealed why the couple chose Scotland as the setting for their celebration and expressed gratitude for the warmth they received during their stay

The actor described the experience as one that went beyond simply marking another year of their marriage, thanking everyone involved in making the occasion memorable.Suriya wrote, "Sharing yet another piece of our heart with you as we are overwhelmed by the love and positivity you've showered on us

A heartfelt thanks to the extraordinary team that has made our wedding in Scotland so unforgettable."Why Scotland felt special to themExplaining their choice of destination, Suriya said Scotland's natural beauty and landscape made it an ideal backdrop for the couple to renew their vows
He also drew a connection between the surroundings and their own journey together.He wrote, "We chose Scotland for its misty highlands and lochs and their love story that mirrored our own
But we came home carrying something greater than memories

Having met people so open-hearted, so genuinely warm, that our hearts will never truly go Scot-free."Their children joined them for the vow renewalThe couple's anniversary celebrations included an intimate ceremony at a church, where they renewed their wedding vows in front of their children, family members and close friends.Suriya and Jyotika were both dressed in white for the occasion
Jyotika opted for a white bridal gown with minimal accessories, while Suriya wore a white tuxedo

Their children, Diya and Dev, played a special part in the ceremony by walking their parents down the aisle.The vows reflected the couple's focus on family, love, health, their children and the relationships they have built over the years

After exchanging vows, the couple were also seen sharing a warm embrace.Family and close friends joined the celebrationsThe ceremony remained a close-knit affair, with several members of both families in attendance

Suriya's brother and actor Karthi was present with his wife Ranjani, while members of Jyotika's family also joined the celebrations.Sharing pictures from the occasion, Jyotika wrote, "Fun, laughter and a memory for life with our most loved ones! Thank you all for being there for us (sic)."Anniversary celebrations continued on a yachtFollowing the church ceremony, the couple continued the celebrations aboard a yacht with their loved ones

They changed into different outfits and spent time with family and friends in a relaxed setting, with photographs capturing the intimate moments from the gathering.Alongside the pictures, Suriya and Jyotika wrote, "Just sharing some moments from our special day with family and friends."The couple had earlier shared another video from the ceremony, with Jyotika describing the vow renewal as "THE SEQUEL"

Reflecting on their relationship, she spoke about the imperfections, adjustments, understanding and sacrifices that have been part of their journey together.Suriya and Jyotika's journey togetherSuriya and Jyotika first met while working together in films and eventually fell in love
The couple got married in Chennai on September 11, 2006

Nearly two decades later, they marked their anniversary by renewing their vows in Scotland, surrounded by their children and their closest family and friends.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more
